answer: Reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so a node must provide sustained honest service to retain influence. EigenTrust derives centrality from normalized trust and transitive support; freshly spawned sybil identities have near-zero centrality because they lack established trusted paths, and reciprocity weighting limits collusive boosts. Thus, whether labeled ember, delta, or wharf, a new identity cannot meet consensus thresholds by appearing alone.
